# Al Etmanski

> A disability advocate, author, and social innovator sharing insights on caregiving, disability rights, and social change through books, essays, and the Disability Digest newsletter.

Al Etmanski is a renowned disability rights activist and founder of the Planned Lifetime Advocacy Network (PLAN). His work focuses on disability advocacy, caregiving solutions, and social innovation across Canada, with particular emphasis on disability benefits policy and improving quality of life for people with disabilities.

## Key Topics

- disability advocacy
- caregiving
- social innovation
